mechanism: A long-decayed field (peak 60.62, now ~7) had spent a month in quiet downward drift (7.10 to 5.68) with high stability and no deaths, then took a single violent upward displacement on 2026-08-19 (5.74 to 7.20, gap open 7.28). The channel could not conduct the impulse: mid-session a channel death fired and URF read 0.000 for three consecutive readings while price faded off the open, and whole-day stability S_UF collapsed to 0.720, the lowest of the window. A late partial re-knit (one ignition, URF back to only 0.442) leaves the pulse largely distributed through a damaged conductor rather than stored as structure, so the displacement should bleed back toward the pre-pulse level.
